== Original printing transcription ==
The original manufacturer face prints X-34 in the Lore. The Lore transcription is corrected from X-24 to X-34. The existing game text correctly says ‘Luke’s X-34 Landspeeder’ and is preserved. The original printing remains unrestricted.<ref>[[Media:Premiere-L-spaceportspeeders-decipher-archive.gif|Original Decipher card face]].</ref> This correction preserves the printed version, existing card mapping and all date fields; it does not assign the later documentary erratum’s date to the original printing. — [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] 19 November 2026 (UTC)
